args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living vs Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads 'Covey — Late Arrivals'.
- The report label looks out of date and may need updating to the Pellow Home Living name.

Sofia Marchetti (Coastal team)
